evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/b extends java.awt.Canvas, stores one delegated Component, and forwards both update(Graphics) and paint(Graphics) directly to that component.
Historical refactored RuneScape clients contain the same wrapper class as RSCanvas: a Canvas holding a delegated Component and forwarding paint/update to it.
SpawnPK v308 extends the classic wrapper with focus suppression/requestFocusInWindow behavior and client-aware setSize handling, but retains the defining RSCanvas delegation contract.
Sibling rs/b/a is R407 MouseDetection, placing rs/b inside the classic low-level client shell/input utility cluster rather than a modern plugin/UI namespace.

proposals.note: Historical RuneScape source identity recovered from exact structural/behavioral match. SpawnPK-specific focus and resize extensions are retained as implementation drift, not a reason to rename the class.
